label: retrospective, previously examined history (2016–2026); illustrative normalization ($500,000 initial core equity), NOT the user’s balance; margin requirements illustrative, not Vanguard’s

conventions.core: 60 % VOOG / 40 % VGT at the 2016-01-04 close; 5 bps per side; quarterly rebalance at the last close of each calendar quarter (primary); distributions entitled at the close before the ex-date, receivable from the ex-date, reinvested in the paying fund at the pay-date close; prices in 2016-01-04 share units (central split ledger)
conventions.overlay: the engine’s marked net (costs and 11 % interest inside, charged once); open lot value and outstanding principal + accrued interest from the same continuous run
conventions.cash: realized overlay P&L; 0 % on positive cash; 11 % simple per calendar day on negative cash (booked quarterly)
